limitations: Original bounded deterministic game and stress file, not an empirical crisis forecast, complete historical explanation, welfare optimum or actual intervention authorization.

Two large observable funders, linear consumption utility, fixed auction absorption law, equal known contracts and no information acquisition; no general continuum-run, equilibrium-selection or dynamic stability theorem.
Buyer demand is stipulated; known fundamental changes may require a different law. Physical output destruction, new-buyer entry, fiscal distortion and ex ante moral hazard are not modeled.
Public cash, fixed appraisal, locked collateral, senior estate recourse and resolution powers are assumptions; real enforceability/availability and operational timing require their own evidence.
Stress values revalue frozen first-cutoff histories without probabilities. Principal marks, waiting-interest obligations, default losses, transfers and ultimate resources are separate quantities.
Numerical near-indifference is explicitly unresolved, not proof of exact equality. Source scope, machine-assisted review, human expert judgment and whole-edition rendered UI are distinct.
